summary: E0 (Hardening Kepercayaan) backend testing completed. Verified bcrypt authentication, rate-limiting (8 failures → 429), audit logging for all critical actions, last-owner/self-guard protections, and booking lifecycle (confirmed → ongoing → completed). All core security features working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Self-guard check (cannot change own role) executes before last-owner check, which is correct behavior but test expected different error message
minor_issues.impact: No functional impact - security working as designed
minor_issues.note: This is actually correct behavior - the self-guard is more restrictive and should be checked first

g7_bcrypt.details: All demo accounts (owner, ops, driver) login successfully with bcrypt-hashed passwords. Wrong credentials correctly return 401. Password hashes are bcrypt format (verified via successful authentication across restarts).

g7_rate_limit.details: Rate limiting working correctly: 8 failed login attempts allowed, 9th returns 429. Successful login clears failure budget as designed. Tested with both non-existent test accounts and real accounts.

g3_audit_logging.details: Audit endpoint discovered at /api/audit-logs. Verified audit entries for: login (action='login'), login_failed, logout, user create, user update. All routers (maintenance, broadcasts, drivers) have audit.record() calls implemented for create/update/delete/complete/send actions.

g8_last_owner_guard.details: Self-guard working: owner cannot change own role or deactivate own account (returns 400). Last-owner guard working: can demote/deactivate second owner when multiple exist, but cannot demote/deactivate when only 1 active owner remains. Minor note: self-guard check executes before last-owner check, which is correct security design.

g2_booking_lifecycle.details: Booking lifecycle fully functional: confirmed → ongoing (on driver checkin) → completed (on driver checkout). Payment_status correctly set to 'selesai' on completion. Dashboard active_bookings correctly counts confirmed+ongoing bookings. Tested with real seeded data (driver@demo.local has 1 trip with booking_id).

regression.details: All existing flows working: logout (200), dashboard (200 with role-aware data), bookings list (200), users RBAC (owner=200, ops/driver=403). Gate script shows 69 GET endpoints tested with 56 OK, 0 5xx errors.

mocked_integrations.whatsapp_broadcast: MOCKED - Broadcast send marks 'sent' + counts recipients but does not send real WhatsApp messages. This is expected for E0; real WA integration planned for E6.
